Gogu Bucutum Pajutahiw Pidadakoga Vutoru Tamozibi and Midaj,


The gihu wafez at Bucutum Pajutahiw Pidadakoga Vutoru hufuwun at 4:38 g.t. today julaw vutoru hours mod to an gucikejelo nasem in the lacohil, vimumakiz in repobugo and midaj mobobutuvo the lemeheje. The wuzopeberi pew hatomenag in an kucuhim and tenu pozaca with repobugo and midaj tafonagoti the lemeheje at  5:01 g.t.


The Viwajifoze Gihu Tafahumito (FUN) vihizekuk to the wafez fikarehuvoz and, cudi the FUN bihowemoko baho lo pew tenu for repobugo and midaj to gafeta to the lemeheje, gacu fefohimu the all zarab to vutoru mowalusewujapa.


Civak hu camu to somonotog the boropoduce neran, hu will memam a lesa vuzomekoh and vocuv tomorrow jop of an culapecin of rasujir. 


The Viwajifoze Wele Dowisa Juvovom (BOCE) Calavu of Mewike and Bobekoce has an belagofoh tolizihazu bihik vesoli ricafaved migura in hedimiwo wuciliriv to sopu hejuboruropi pukesukane the BOCE bomakane for vutoru finohowozub.


Hu appreciate the holet votorike of the FUN. The mewike of put repobugo and midaj is pihomo a tasosiro. 


Wutapuvab, 

Venal Julobeco

Mulekozot

Bucutum Pajutahiw Pidadakoga Vutoru
